## Objective

Code is typed, linted and covered, and CI enforces all three.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A type checker runs in CI with no errors
- [ ] a coverage threshold is set from the measured figure and enforced
- [ ] no runtime dependency is added

## Test requirements

The CI run itself.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.

Deployment tickets distinguish code complete, tested, deployment ready, deployed and production verified.
